notes.title: 0.2.1 Spring Festival Special
notes.content:
Firstly, highlight these:

[list]
[*] 6 Director's Cut CGs (Mai, Jiya, Yuua)
[*] 5 Small CGs with speed control (Freya, Linger, Elisa 2, Amy)
[/list]


1. Calendar System:
You can check characters' daily events in the phone's calendar. I will complete 30 events in the future. (Currently, there's one for Linger's defeat and one for Elisa.)
It also displays the events of the current quest character on the calendar. There might be some bugs, but they should not affect the main storyline.
It seems the display for English looks a little bit odd. I will look into it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049523/125affd28b33c82907f2bef9978da1741cb6ec1b.jpg[/img]

2. Real-Time Location System under Character Information Interface:
The current location information of characters at any given time will be displayed in the character information interface.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049523/4858adc03e36c1487892d0fa2ef05912a37d8a9f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049523/5d791ec0d2f70167f568ea2b13f2f9087c6993f3.jpg[/img]



3. Mini Roaming System:
During the execution of main tasks, you can engage in small roams to enhance the game immersion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049523/4f7cc7aab8441a93e5a66a022dab4ea4ec71466d.jpg[/img]




4. 4 Main Questlines (The Chinese New Year quest triggers the other three):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049523/7c2ff7e8d24047169eec95709d5157423866ebb4.jpg[/img]
Due to the extensive modification of cache code this time, everyone who encounters save errors might need to replay Chapter 11. I deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused, but I will continue to work tirelessly. I am the Zhuge Liang of the eroge world.


Finally, Happy Chinese New Year to you~! I wish you prosperity!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049523/13d367e9bb714b8ec3bf1d3c459b9e2e7021dbef.jpg[/img]
